jobs.description:
SeeZeit – German-Mediterranean restaurant in Plön 

Plön is known as the ‘Jewel of Holstein Switzerland’ and is situated on the beautiful Lake Plön. Attractive places to visit include the charming old town, a castle visible from afar, Prinzeninsel (Prince’s Island) and the promenade. And the state capital, Kiel, is only around 30 minutes away.

At our new restaurant, SeeZeit, up to 100 guests can not only enjoy our German-Mediterranean cuisine in a cosy atmosphere, but also hire an additional room for special occasions. Whether it’s a birthday, family celebration, corporate event or other occasion – we offer a separate, inviting area that can accommodate groups of various sizes. This ensures that every celebration with us is a relaxed and successful experience.

We are looking for a reliable kitchen and service staff members (m/f/d) with professional experience. The position is initially planned on a part-time basis. There is the prospect of a long-term full-time role in the future.

Your tasks

- Assisting with the preparation of food and drinks
- Cleaning and maintaining kitchen facilities and equipment
- Adherence to hygiene and safety standards in the kitchen
- Team-oriented collaboration with other kitchen staff
or
- Providing service and advice to our national and international guests
- Taking orders and serving food and drinks

What you bring to the role

- Experience
- Knowledge of English, ideally also good knowledge of German
- Ability to work well in a team
- Reliability, even in busy situations

What we offer

- A motivated, new and friendly team
- Fair pay
- A pleasant working environment
- Support with dealing with the authorities
- Support with finding accommodation

We look forward to receiving your application – and to meeting you.

Your contact person is Mr Moussa.

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer – Advanced Materials (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Chemietechnik)
jobs.description:
Key Facts at a glance:

- In your role as Process Engineer (all genders), you will be responsible for operating an AIXTRON CCS or Planetary system in our application laboratory.
- You will serve as the direct contact for the Simulation and Design departments regarding process
optimization and further development of reactor hardware.
- In addition, you will work closely with colleagues from Sales & Marketing and conduct system
demonstrations to support customer acquisition. You will also contribute to cooperation projects with internal and external partners.

In Detail

- As a process engineer in the AIXTRON application laboratory, you will actively and independently shape the development and optimization of our deposition reactors and processes for compound semiconductor deposition.
- Thanks to your independent and well-coordinated working style, you will plan and manage cross-departmental projects to further develop our deposition processes and drive the evaluation of hardware prototypes.
- Your fascination with technology and your pursuit of perfection will motivate you to design and coordinate sometimes complex test series within development projects.
- Turning data into information: With your structured and scientific-analytical approach, you will recognize complex relationships and draw conclusions from experimental series.
- As a multiplier of our know-how, you will carefully analyze and document the knowledge and experience gained and share it with colleagues and team members.
- You will be able to adapt processes developed in the laboratory to customer requirements and transfer them to customer systems, making a key contribution to ensuring our customers’ rapid success.

Your Profile

- You hold a degree in a scientific or technical field, e.g., Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a comparable qualification.
- During your studies and professional experience, you have developed solid expertise in CMOS technology, advanced material deposition, semiconductor processing, and solid-state physics. In addition, you possess in-depth knowledge of epitaxial growth processes for both Group III–V and Group IV materials, which you confidently apply in practice.
- You have process experience in semiconductor deposition, ideally using RPCVD on a commercial epitaxy system. Knowledge of other growth techniques such as MBE, ALD, or sputtering is also advantageous.
- You are experienced in handling various characterization methods and solid-state physics-related questions and have worked with measurement equipment.
- You have good written and spoken English skills.
- You are flexible and open to international travel (approximately 5–10%).

What you can expect from us

- Flexible working hours: No fixed core hours, mobile working options, and the ability to switch between office and mobile office.
- Vacation: 30 vacation days as standard, with the option to increase annually through salary conversion.
- Profit sharing: Opportunity to participate in the company’s success and benefit from profit sharing.
- Health: Promotion of your physical and mental health through regular health initiatives.
- Further development: Continuous development through the AIXTRON Academy and individual support programs.
- Retirement and additional insurance: Support for pension plans, capital-forming benefits, and additional insurance options.
- Catering: Subsidized meals in the company cafeteria and fresh seasonal fruit baskets.
- Open corporate culture: Open and respectful informal culture (“Duz”) across all hierarchy levels.
- Sustainability and mobility: E-charging stations for cars and bicycles, good public transport connections, and free parking.
- Employee referral program: Attractive rewards for referring new talent to AIXTRON.

Your missionTo support the Group's growth ambitions, EP Power Grit Group is seeking a Product Manager (m/f/d).

The Product Manager is responsible for the strategic development and lifecycle management of the company's product portfolio. The role ensures that customer requirements, market developments, technical capabilities and commercial objectives are translated into competitive products and sustainable growth opportunities.

The responsibilities for this role will be:
Product Portfolio Management
• Own and continuously develop the global product portfolio across blasting abrasives and industrial minerals.
• Manage the complete product lifecycle from product introduction to phase-out.
• Define portfolio priorities and support portfolio simplification.
• Monitor product profitability and recommend portfolio improvements.

Product Development & Innovation
• Identify customer needs and translate them into new product concepts.
• Lead product development projects in collaboration with Operations, Procurement and Quality.
• Support the introduction of sustainable and innovative product solutions.
• Evaluate new raw materials, applications and technologies.

Market & Customer Insights
• Analyze market trends, customer requirements and competitive developments.
• Build structured customer and application knowledge.
• Identify new applications and market opportunities.
• Develop business cases for new products and portfolio extensions.

Commercial Product Management
• Develop compelling product positioning and customer value propositions.
• Support value-based pricing together with Sales.
• Prepare product documentation, technical data sheets and application guides.
• Support strategic customer projects, key tenders and technical presentations.
• Deliver product and application training to Sales teams and distributors.

Cross-functional Collaboration
• Act as the central interface between Sales, Operations, Procurement, Supply Chain and Quality.
• Ensure customer requirements are reflected in product specifications and manufacturing capabilities.
• Coordinate product launches and product changes across all functions.
• Support continuous product improvement initiatives.

Your profile
• 5–10 years of experience in Product Management, Product Development, Portfolio Management or Technical Sales within an industrial B2B environment.
• Experience in abrasives, industrial minerals, construction materials, steel, chemicals or related industries is advantageous.
• Strong understanding of product lifecycle management.
• Commercial mindset combined with technical understanding.
• Experience working closely with Sales and Operations.
• Strong analytical and project management skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent English required; German advantageous.

Why us?"For big ideas with strong partners. Now and in the future." This is our claim, which we stride to fulfil every day anew for our customers in many countries around the world. This commitment shapes your future working environment and creates success together. We are future-oriented, international, and diverse. Your personal and professional development is as important to us, as well as a good work-life balance, a flexible working hours model and an attractive remuneration package.

About usWe are EP Power Grit GmbH based in Oberhausen and specialized in abrasives and industrial minerals based on slags, minerals, glass and other raw materials. The environmentally friendly products are effectively used for surface cleaning in industry, on buildings and ships, for water jet cutting or as decorative building materials. Smart logistics services tailored to customer needs promise additional benefits. With proven production facilities, we produce high-quality abrasives at our sites in Germany and, since December 2022, at additional sites in Belgium, the Netherlands and Finland. We are a subsidiary of EP Power Minerals GmbH and thus part of the Central European energy group Energetický a průmyslový holding (EPH).

CS-International is a fast-growing international company operating in the trading card game, collectibles, gaming and entertainment industries.As our business continues to grow, we are building and professionalizing our warehouse and logistics operations in Ratingen. We are therefore looking for a hands-on Junior Warehouse & Logistics Manager who wants to take real ownership, develop scalable processes and grow into a future leadership position.This is not a purely administrative role. You will work directly within the operation, help establish our systems and processes from scratch and gradually take over responsibility for the entire warehouse and logistics function.

• Support the setup and continuous development of our warehouse and logistics operations in our brand new warehouse in Ratingen
• Help design efficient processes for inbound goods, storage, picking, packing, shipping and returns
• Actively participate in day-to-day warehouse operations, particularly during the setup phase and peak periods
• Support the implementation and configuration of our new ERP and warehouse management processes
• Translate operational requirements into practical ERP workflows together with management, internal teams and external implementation partners
• Establish clear processes for inventory management, stock accuracy, cycle counts and annual stocktaking
• Help define warehouse layouts, storage locations, product flows and picking structures
• Coordinate parcel and freight shipments as well as relationships with carriers and logistics service providers
• Monitor operational performance and develop relevant KPIs and reports
• Identify bottlenecks, errors and inefficient processes and implement practical improvements
• Create and maintain process documentation, work instructions and operational standards
• Gradually coordinate and lead warehouse employees and temporary staff
• Support logistics planning for events, conventions, retail activities and international projects
• Work closely with Events/Organized Play, Project Management and Management
• Take on increasing responsibility with the long-term perspective of leading our warehouse and logistics department
• Grow gradually into this role, having the opportunity to become part of our management

Qualifications
• Completed vocational training or a degree in logistics, supply chain management, business administration or a comparable field
• Approximately two to three years of relevant professional experience in warehousing, logistics, fulfilment or supply chain operations
• Practical understanding of inbound goods, storage, inventory management, picking, packing, shipping and returns
• Confident use of Microsoft Office applications and general familiarity with digital business systems
• Very good written and spoken German and good written and spoken English (Our main language is ENGLISH!)

Experience with ERP or warehouse management systems, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, Shopify, shipping software, international logistics or the coordination of operational teams would be an advantage, but is not essential.

• You work in a structured, accurate and independent manner and take ownership of your responsibilities
• You are able to identify operational problems and develop practical, workable solutions
• You communicate reliably and enjoy working across departments and with external service providers
• You are motivated to support the implementation of a new ERP and warehouse management structure, you are a stakeholder in this process
• You are comfortable working in a growing environment where processes are still being developed
• You have the ambition to gradually take on leadership responsibility and develop into the future head of our warehouse and logistics operations

What matters most to us is your understanding of warehouse operations, your willingness to actively build new structures and your motivation to grow into a responsible leadership position. We want to help you developing with workshops etc. in areas you are not 100% confident.

• The opportunity to actively shape workflows, warehouse structures and operational standards
• Direct involvement in the implementation of our new ERP and warehouse management processes
• A varied position combining hands-on warehouse operations, process development and project work
• A high level of ownership and the freedom to contribute and implement your own ideas

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Theoretical Condensed Matter Physics (three years) (m/f/x) (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (29.8725 hours/week = 75%;) by 12-2026, we are looking for one

PhD Position in Theoretical Condensed Matter Physics (three years) (m/f/x)

The Research Group of Prof. Ilya M. Eremin at Theoretical Physics III at Ruhr University Bochum conducts research on the theory of quantum materials, with a particular focus on strongly correlated electron systems, unconventional superconductivity, magnetism, and collective phenomena. Our research aims at developing a microscopic understanding of emergent electronic phases in quantum materials and their experimentally observable signatures. A central focus of our current research is the physics of unconventional superconductors and correlated quantum materials, including recently discovered nickelate superconductors. These systems provide a particularly rich platform in which electronic correlations, orbital degrees of freedom, magnetism, structural effects, and superconductivity are intimately intertwined. Understanding their phase diagrams and excitation spectra requires the development and application of advanced many-body theoretical approaches.

One PhD position in Theoretical Condensed Matter Physics is available in the Research Group Theoretical Physics III at Ruhr University Bochum. The successful candidate will investigate microscopic mechanisms of unconventional superconductivity and competing electronic phases in strongly correlated quantum materials. Particular emphasis will be placed on multiorbital systems such as bilayer and multilayer nickelates, although related problems in cuprates and other unconventional superconductors may also be addressed. The project will combine analytical and numerical many-body techniques, including tight-binding and multiorbital models, Green's-function methods, mean-field and Bogoliubov–de Gennes approaches, and methods for treating electronic correlations and collective excitations. Depending on the specific research direction and the candidate's interests, functional renormalization group, slave-boson/Gutzwiller approaches, random-phase approximation, and numerical calculations of experimentally measurable response functions may also be employed. An important aspect of the project will be the close connection between microscopic theory and current experiments, including spectroscopy, transport, and scattering measurements. The PhD researcher will work in an active international research environment and interact closely with theoretical and experimental collaborators in Germany and abroad.

Scope: part-time
Duration: fixed-term, 3 Jahre
Start: by 12-2026
Apply by:  2026-10-05

Your tasks:

- Development and investigation of microscopic theoretical models for strongly correlated quantum materials and unconventional superconductors.
- Study of superconductivity, magnetism, density-wave states, and competing or intertwined electronic orders in multiorbital systems.
- Analytical and numerical calculation of electronic structures, superconducting gap functions, collective excitations, and experimentally accessible response functions.
- Development and application of advanced many-body methods, depending on the specific research problem.
- Comparison of theoretical predictions with experimental results from spectroscopy, transport, and scattering experiments.
- Development, implementation, and documentation of numerical codes for theoretical calculations.
- Close collaboration with other members of the research group and with national and international theoretical and experimental partners.
- Presentation of research results at national and international conferences, workshops, and scientific meetings.
- Publication of the results in international peer-reviewed scientific journals.

Your profile:

- A successfully completed university degree (Master's degree or equivalent) in physics, with a strong background in theoretical physics.
- Very good knowledge of quantum mechanics and solid-state physics.
- A strong interest in condensed matter theory, quantum many-body physics, and unconventional superconductivity.
- Previous knowledge of many-body theory, superconductivity, magnetism, strongly correlated systems, or quantum field theoretical methods is advantageous.
- Experience with numerical calculations and scientific programming, for example in Python, C/C++, Julia, Mathematica, or comparable environments, is desirable.
- Candidates should be motivated to develop and apply analytical as well as numerical theoretical methods.
- Ability to work independently and reliably while contributing actively to collaborative research projects.
- Good communication skills and willingness to work in an international and interdisciplinary research environment.
- Good command of written and spoken English is expected.

https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/76d5e2ffa6aeb65ee350dd2e4608df0fd642d8990?ref=AfA (https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/76d5e2ffa6aeb65ee350dd2e4608df0fd642d8990?ref=AfA)
